run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the GTestXMLOutputUnitTest suite to validate Google Test XML output generation
test_non_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest program generates the expected non-empty XML output with test results
test_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest program with no tests produces valid empty XML output
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in gtest XML output is a valid ISO datetime
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test that gtest XML output only includes tests matching a filter pattern
